rootCauseFindings.finding1_cumulativeSessionTrajectoryRepo: When agy resumes a session via `--conversation <sessionId>` in Turn 2, InitializeConversationResponse loads the existing trajectory and emits cumulative (Turn 1 + Turn 2) token usage and duration_seconds in Turn 2's terminal result event. Summing t1 + t2Reported in v2 computed (2 * Turn 1 + Turn 2), double-counting Turn 1 tokens and Turn 1 API duration in every evidence cell.
rootCauseFindings.finding2_reconciledInputTokensLowerThanM: Once Turn 1 double-counting is removed, reconciled total input tokens for evidence are LOWER than both mcp_digest and raw on both models: on gemini-4-argon-high, evidence uses 334,663 input tokens (118,529 uncached) vs 340,188 (mcp_digest) and 514,809 (raw); on gemini-3.8-flash-high, evidence uses 2,679,205 input tokens (765,915 uncached) vs 3,368,097 (mcp_digest) and 4,351,486 (raw).
rootCauseFindings.finding3_turn1Consumes58To72PercentOfEvi: Even after reconciliation, 58.0% of evidence input tokens on gemini-4-argon-high (194,206 / 334,663) and 72.2% on gemini-3.8-flash-high (1,934,071 / 2,679,205) are consumed inside Turn 1 (analysis) across 21 (Argon) and 87 (Flash) Turn 1 tool calls while the agent independently inspects workspace files before the worker's evidence is delivered.
rootCauseFindings.finding4_wgWaitBlocksDeliveryBy30To88Sec: The background GatherEvidence worker completes all initial MCP digests and 3-4 live Cloudflare Clef iterative steps in 2.15s - 5.18s, but internal/perfdigest/run.go waits at wg.Wait() for Turn 1's CLI process to exit (34.9s - 91.8s) before running verification and starting Turn 2, creating a 29.7s - 88.4s evidence-ready-to-delivery delay.
